title.narrative: Mainstreaming the sound management of chemicals into national planning and strengthening regulatory frameworks

description.narrative: The Global Framework on Chemicals (GFC) – For a planet free of harm from chemicals and waste was formally established at the fifth International Conference on Chemicals Management (ICCM5) in Bonn, Germany, held on September 25-29, 2023. The Global Framework presents a comprehensive plan with 5 strategic objectives and 28 targets to guide countries and stakeholders in jointly addressing the lifecycle of chemicals, including products and waste.This project will support the Government of Rwanda to improve its capacity towards the achievement of the Global Framework on Chemicals Target A1 “Adopt, implement, and enforce legal frameworks by 2030”, Target E1 “Mainstream the sound management of chemicals in all relevant sectoral plans, budgets, and development plans” and Target E3 “identification of adequate, predictable and sustainable financial resources”. Furthermore, the project will inform the implementation of the GFC and the development of its Implementation Programmes (IPs), contribute to safeguarding environmental and human health, economic and social benefits, as well as gender equality.To ensure consolidation of efforts, co-financing opportunities and amplified results, the proposed project will be aligned with related projects in Rwanda that aim to contribute to the achievement of chemicals-related Convention objectives, including GFC targets.
